scope: Native negotiated queue room-making and rear-to-front dependency execution
findings: DrivingOperationStep/AssistStart already own finite owner callbacks and sole ordinary speed writer. Queue work must integrate there, not spawn another movement controller.

Current pass context returns observing-client owner plus exactly two participant rows. Its broker and request serial are passing-specific; using passing ACK as queue consent would misrepresent intent and omit chain membership.
DrivingOperationFinish and AssistRelease are required teardown hooks; pending queue cleanup must run before restoring exact speed baseline.
DrivingRearClear supplies bounded physical/approach observations, not participant consent, support geometry or native reverse success.

Public recovery journal and actor/group locality may split. A queue episode must cancel on owner changes without replaying reverse; exact cleanup identity must survive until actual owner can retire it.

limits.discovery_budget: Use current limiting traffic contact; one bounded rear-chain discovery, at most64 candidates. Refuse overflow, no selected-prefix safety.

binding: canonical ordered participant vehicle rows, excluding observing clientOwner
each role: HOLD_CROSSING, YIELD_ROOT or REAR_ROOM
dependency indices, acyclic and inside participant roster
vehicle/driver/commander/group ownership, group epoch and driving generation
original native command types/destinations, complete authored MOVE route receipt
original snapshot poses and approved bounded rear target per reverse leg

messages.BEGIN: Authenticated current initiator owner submits proposal and original receipts, not movement permission. Server verifies live topology, limits, no overlaps/cycles, and exact role/dependency payload.
messages.VERIFY: Server sends same immutable token/roles/roster/deadlines to every required owner.
messages.ACK: Only expected current owners may accept their own exact local rows and roles. Missing, refused, late or duplicate conflicting replies cannot commit.
messages.COMMIT: After every owner consents, exact original episode installs locally. No initial ACK grants movement.
messages.READY: Existing owner callback applies its own hold through sole cap writer and observes actual stationary pose; sends token/participant/phase-bound readiness.
messages.ROOM_OBSERVED: Executing rear participant reports measured displacement/hull room with exact native command/pose/phase; recipient independently rechecks local room before its leg.
messages.RELEASE: Either original participant owner or server invalidation may retire exact episode; newer orders/episodes remain protected.

execution_rules: No automatic priority to drive through another hull. Deterministic tie-breaking chooses proposed roles only; every actual owner must consent.
Observe both roots stationary for continuous5s with anchored poses; do not reinterpret authored STOP/HOLD, service, tactical reservations, players or external controllers as a jam to override.
Check whole roster before any command; issue only one dependency leaf reverse leg at a time. Moving rear traffic, missing support or any obstacle refuses.
Use native AI movement only. Native reverse is not proved by a negative forceSpeed, command acceptance, elapsed time or changed desired destination.
Observe negative forward velocity, rear displacement within approved corridor, bounded heading change, full-hull clearance and no damage. Abort a native U-turn or unsupported rear request.
Fresh rear/body/traffic checks retain authority throughout each native leg. Front movement cancels further backing; stop only exact owned leg and preserve safe route handback.
Do not release upstream dependency on report/timer alone; it independently observes sufficient physical room.
Interruption, feature disable, participant death/deletion/locality change, unrelated native commands, expired consent or changed role topology end execution. No reverse replay on migration.
Cleanup must retain exact deferred native-command and cap-baseline ownership; do not repeat known whole-subsystem-off lost-observer gap.
Cycles, fifth participant, dense discovery or unavailable consent retain ordinary safe waiting and explicit failure; never push, teleport, alter collision or ignore traffic.

forceSpeed.verified: Official command describes a speed limit; negative value restores default. Not a reverse primitive.

sendSimpleCommand.verified: BACK exists, but documentation warns driver-as-effective-commander can refuse drive commands. Native-only applicability must be proven per crew configuration; do not change commanders solely to make probe pass.

setDriveOnPath.verification: Direct official fetch returned403; no verified negative-speed/reverse guarantee. Do not assume one.

required_physical_cases: Two stationary oncoming roots, server-owned and separate actual-provider HC-owned; real rear room then authored travel for both.
Three/four participant rear dependency chain, blocked tail, moving rear traffic, and dense overflow.
Single-driver and driver/commander native reverse capability; wheels/tracks/mixed mass; measured slope/support.
Intentional native STOP/HOLD, personal GETOUT/FOLLOW/MOVE and convoy/external owner exclusion.
New waypoint and Zeus interruption in every phase, real replacement-order travel and repeated use.
Participant death, vehicle deletion, split locality, owner disconnect, subsystem disable with deferred handback.
Duplicate/out-of-order/forged ACK/progress/release, clock/epoch changes, expired messages and topology replacement.
No damage/continuous hull clearance plus actual before/after queue throughput.
Normal/providerHC batches separate; matched overhead<=5%median/10%p95 including dense and many-queue cases.
acceptance: No queue behaviour implementation or parity credit from this contract. Existing route retries are separate. Audits paused, all65 feature families partial.
